steps.title: Step 2: The Dopamine & Gut Reset
steps.subtitle: Repairing Your Second Brain & Cravings
steps.description: Your mind-gut coach targets what keeps you on edge: the 3 PM coffee crash, late dinners, and 1 AM mindless phone scrolling.
keyPoints: These habits aren’t a discipline problem — your brain is simply chasing quick chemical relief.
You’ll make small, office-friendly swaps with zero 6 AM meal prep and no giving up everything you love.
Your energy steadies throughout high-pressure work days, and relentless sugar/caffeine cravings fade away naturally.

steps.title: Step 3: The 6-Axis Body Unlock
steps.subtitle: Releasing Stored Trauma & Chronic Tension
steps.description: Your somatic reset coach releases years of stored stress: the hunched posture, locked shoulders, and tight chest before every team review.
keyPoints: Combines 6-direction spinal movements, Bhramari pranayama, 4-7-8 vagus nerve breathing, and restorative Yoga Nidra customised for your body.
Requires just 10 minutes a day, plus 2-minute discreet desk resets you can do between Zoom calls.
Within weeks, your autonomic nervous system finally switches from 'fight-or-flight' to rest, and your body stops bracing all day.

steps.title: Step 4: The Habit Lock-In & Accountability Protocol
steps.subtitle: Permanent Calm as Your Default Baseline
steps.description: Most wellness programs fail the moment work gets busy. That’s why your accountability coach checks in daily on your sleep, movement, nutrition, and mood.
keyPoints: Guided somatic journaling helps you pinpoint mental loops like 'I keep replaying difficult conversations in my head.'
You’ll build a customized personal SOS plan so you know the exact 90-second protocol to run when panic or acute anger strikes.
By Day 90, calm stops being something you desperately chase. It becomes your effortless daily default.

faqs.question: How is this different from regular talk therapy or psychiatry?
faqs.answer: Traditional talk therapy focuses primarily on the intellectual/cognitive mind, while psychiatry often relies on pharmaceutical sedatives. Our 6-Axis Psycho-Somatic method addresses the root nervous system dysregulation stored physically in your fascia, gut-brain axis, and breathing mechanics. We don't just talk about trauma; we physically unlock the stress patterns holding it.

faqs.question: Do I need to take pills, medications, or expensive supplements?
faqs.answer: No. The entire methodology is 100% natural and drug-free. We use targeted somatic resets, spinal realignment, vagal nerve stimulation, circadian rhythm corrections, and practical dietary adjustments.

faqs.question: I have an extremely busy corporate work schedule. Can I really do this?
faqs.answer: Yes! The program is specifically built for busy working professionals and entrepreneurs. The core routine requires only 10–15 minutes each morning, plus 2-minute micro desk resets you can do between meetings without anyone noticing.

faqs.question: What happens during the Free Anxiety-Breakdown Consultation?
faqs.answer: In your private 1-on-1 session, we review your current symptoms, identify your primary stress triggers, assess your somatic tension areas (neck, jaw, chest, gut), and map out a tailored 3-week roadmap to reset your nervous system.

faqs.question: What is the 'Or Otherwise We Do It For Free' guarantee?
faqs.answer: We stand 100% behind the 6-Axis Method. If you follow your customized daily protocols and don't see a significant measurable improvement in your Anxiety & Mental Health Score within 3 weeks, we continue coaching you free of charge until you achieve the promised transformation.
